items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I hired Louis Armstrong to play. Louis Armstrong and Joe Lindsey. And I played the trombone.

ctx.x: How did I play the trombone?

Well, I was playing the trombone. Well, how did I see the way that started? I couldn't find any trombone player or something. So it was easy to get a trumpet player. So I thought I'd go ahead and pick up on the trombone, see? And took a few lessons on the trombone. And I think one job, if I'm not mistaken, a job we played in Kenner. I think it was Kenner, Louisiana, someplace there. I hired Louis Armstrong to play. Louis Armstrong and Joe Lindsey. And I played the trombone. Louis played the cornet then, see? And…

No, they sent to me, coming from St. Louis. But on Easter Monday morning, you see? You know, when I gave him my award, they were going to organize a band. And sent for me to come and meet the both, coming in the office. Well, I gave them my award. And the time didn't come, he wrote, that is, the road last time. And so, uh... We, uh... We played with Oak, Dad. That's San Suo Hall. You remember that? Well... All right. I said, I showed Sidney the telegram on Monday night. You remember San Suo Hall? You forgot that?…
